meta.title: Sleep-stage scoring from EEG (Sleep-EDF)
meta.tools: 30-s epoch spectral features (δ, θ, α, σ, β band powers, EOG & EMG power) + softmax classifier; Sleep-EDF Expanded cassette recordings
meta.summary: Score Wake, N1, N2, N3 and REM on whole-night recordings using band powers of the Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz EEG, EOG and chin EMG; train on one night, test on a different subject's night, and compare with human inter-scorer agreement.
meta.problem: Sleep technicians label every 30 s of a night by eye. How far does a simple spectral classifier get toward that?
meta.method:
Train: SC4001 night 1; test: SC4011 night 1 (different subject). Epochs from 30 min before sleep onset to 30 min after the last sleep epoch. Features: log relative
band powers of both EEG channels (Welch, 4-s segments), EOG power 0.5–5 Hz, EMG (1 Hz envelope channel) mean; standardised; softmax regression with
class weighting. Accuracy, per-class recall and Cohen's κ.
meta.data: Real: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded (Kemp et al. 2000, PhysioNet), ODC-By.

rows.quantity: Accuracy on an unseen subject's night (simple classifiers: 70–80 %)
